GAP LE Bond Manager Exported Types

group GAP_LE_BOND_MANAGER_Exported_Types

Enums

enum T_LE_BOND_PARAM_TYPE

LE bond parameter types.

Values:

enumerator GAP_PARAM_BOND_OOB_DATA

Out of Band data. Read/Write. Size is 16 octets GAP_OOB_LEN. Default value is all zero.

enumerator GAP_PARAM_BOND_FIXED_PASSKEY

The fixed passkey for MITM protection. Read/Write. Size is 4 octets. Range is 000,000 - 999,999. Default value is 0.

enumerator GAP_PARAM_BOND_FIXED_PASSKEY_ENABLE

The fixed passkey available for pairing. Read/Write. Size is 1 octet. Default value is 0 (disabled).

enumerator GAP_PARAM_BOND_SEC_REQ_ENABLE

Whether to start pairing procedure or encryption procedure when connected. Read/Write. Size is 1 octet. Default value is 0 (disabled).

enumerator GAP_PARAM_BOND_SEC_REQ_REQUIREMENT

Authentication requirements. Read/Write. Size is 2 octets. Value is Authentication Requirements. Default value is GAP_AUTHEN_BIT_BONDING_FLAG.

enumerator GAP_PARAM_BOND_MIN_KEY_SIZE

Minimum LTK size required. Read/Write. Size is 1 octet. Range is 7 - 16. Default value is 7.

enumerator GAP_PARAM_BOND_GEN_LOCAL_IRK_AUTO

Whether to auto generate local IRK. Write only. Size is 1 octet. Default value is 0 (disabled).

enumerator GAP_PARAM_BOND_SET_LOCAL_IRK

Set local IRK. Write only. Size is 16 octets. Default value is all zero.

enumerator GAP_PARAM_BOND_KEY_MANAGER

The way to implement bonding key management. Write only. Size is 1 octet. Value range:

  • 0: GAP implements bonding key management.

  • 1: GAP does not implement bonding key management.

  • 2: GAP implements bonding key management. When receiving GAP_MSG_LE_BOND_KEY_REQ, APP shall handle the message. Default value is 0.

enumerator GAP_PARAM_BOND_SIGN_KEY_FLAG

Whether to distribute CSRK when pairing. Write only. Size is 1 octet. Default value is 0 (disabled).

enumerator GAP_PARAM_BOND_CCCD_STORAGE

Whether to store CCCD information. Write only. Size is 1 octet. Default value is 1 (enabled).
